actions.description: Advance the simulated world by a bounded number of fixed timesteps, optionally applying an action for each step, and return the resulting observation and terminal flags.

inputs.description: Transitions to advance; the action is applied at every tick
inputs.name: ticks

inputs.description: The action applied at each tick, shaped by the environment's action space
inputs.name: action

actions.name: step

actions.description: Reset the simulated world to a scenario start state and return the initial observation. When a seed is supplied the endpoint records it in the receipt; otherwise the endpoint's declared default seed applies.

inputs.description: Seed of the environment's random generator
inputs.name: seed

actions.name: reset

actions.description: Set the seed used by the simulated world's random number generators for subsequent steps, without resetting the world. The accepted seed is echoed in the receipt.

inputs.description: Seed used by the next reset
inputs.name: seed

facts.text: RoboCAS is a benchmark for robotic manipulation in complex object arrangement scenarios, run in a physical simulation environment
The benchmark needs the PartNet-Mobility and GraspNet-1Billion assets in the assets directory
TaskBaseEnv imports BaseEnv from mani_skill2.envs.sapien_env
The entry class TaskBaseEnv subclasses BaseEnv and supports the simulated mobile Franka Panda robot
TaskBaseEnv fixes robot_uid to mobile_franka_panda
TaskBaseEnv's default control mode is base_pd_pos_arm_pd_ee_abs_pose_wrt_arm_base
TaskBaseEnv defaults to sim_freq 240 and control_freq 10
The benchmark configuration sets obs_mode image and control_freq 5
The arm controller for the default mode is the absolute end-effector pose controller relative to the arm base
The base joint-position controller takes its limits from the model
The absolute end-effector pose controller uses position bounds [-1, -1, 0] to [1, 1, 1.5]
The rotation bound of the absolute end-effector pose controller is pi
The gripper controller bounds each finger joint from -0.01 to 0.04
controller_configs composes each control mode from a base, an arm and a gripper controller
The base, gripper and static cameras are configured at 640 x 480
The mobile base joint limits are x -0.2 to 0.8, y -0.8 to 0.8 and rotation z -3.1415926 to 1.5707
The gripper finger joints are limited 0 to 0.04 in the URDF
TaskBaseEnv.reset delegates to its superclass reset
TaskBaseEnv.evaluate is marked Not Implemented and returns {'success': True}
TaskBaseEnv.compute_normalized_dense_reward returns 0
TaskBaseEnv.set_main_rng ignores its seed argument and draws a random seed
The upstream dependencies include gymnasium>=0.28.1, sapien==2.2.2 and mplib==0.1.0
TaskBaseEnv.get_images converts the camera colours, positions and segmentations for all cameras
The agent's initial joint positions are the 12 values in init_qpos

determinism.notes: the fake seeds its initial end-effector jitter from reset(seed) or cap.world.seed.v1 and its transitions are deterministic; upstream BaseEnv.reset uses the seed for the episode RNG, but TaskBaseEnv.set_main_rng discards it (basic_env.py:69-70) and object placement draws from numpy's global RNG, so upstream is not exactly reproducible either

gaps: no dynamics: the fake echoes the commanded base joint positions, end-effector pose and gripper width and derives velocities by finite difference; SAPIEN rigid-body integration, contacts, friction, inverse kinematics and the PartNet-Mobility / GraspNet scene are not modelled (the upstream engine would be F1, the deployed fake is F0)

observation surrogate: 22 floats (11 state values and 11 velocities), while the upstream state observation is a richer robot/controller state vector and the benchmark configuration observes 640 x 480 x 3 RGB images from three cameras (robot_sim/config/env/common.yaml:20 and robot_sim/agents/configs/mobile_franka_panda/defaults.py:372-408)

termination: upstream TaskBaseEnv.evaluate is a stub returning success True (basic_env.py:322-324), so every upstream step terminates; the fake mirrors terminated=True and the driver sets autoreset=True so the bridge starts the next episode before stepping again

seeding is partial upstream: TaskBaseEnv.set_main_rng discards the seed (basic_env.py:69-70) and object placement draws from numpy's global RNG; the fake's deterministic stream is Python random.Random(seed), not numpy's
no rendering, no assets, no GPU and no ManiSkill2 submodule: the fake returns plain Python floats where upstream returns numpy arrays

the sim backend (gymnasium.make on the class entry point) needs SAPIEN, ManiSkill2, the initialised submodule and the PartNet-Mobility / GraspNet data; it was not installed or run, only the fake backend was
snapshot and restore are not offered: TaskBaseEnv exposes no get_state/set_state pair the bridge could use

measures.description: Last observation (derived from the observation space)
measures.name: observation

safe_state.description: the simulation stops advancing: no step or reset is accepted after an e-stop until mhs.safety.reset clears the latch; the environment state is kept and stays readable
